description: This file defines the 'FileChooser' class, which manages file input dialogs within a web page context. It provides methods to access the associated element, check if multiple files can be selected, retrieve the page, and set files for upload, typically used within a web automation or testing framework.

classes.name: FileChooser
classes.description: A class representing a file input chooser in a web page, allowing automation scripts to interact with file upload inputs.

methods.name: element
methods.description: Returns the element handle associated with the file input element.

methods.name: isMultiple
methods.description: Indicates whether the file input allows multiple files to be selected.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Returns the page instance associated with this file chooser.

methods.name: setFiles
methods.description: Sets the files to be uploaded via the file input element, supporting various input types and options.
